## 1. Directory Architecture
ListAIAssets is organized into 18 specialized production verticals to eliminate generic search noise and provide developers with exact performance benchmarks:
- /categories: Hub displaying all 18 verticals, average starting prices, and empirical ratings.
- /categories/[slug]: Granular deep-dive into tools belonging to an exact vertical with latency benchmarks and pricing filters.
- /tools: Full searchable directory with multi-attribute filtering (pricing, features, benchmarks).
- /compare/[slug]: Head-to-head empirical comparison matrix with token latency, reasoning score, and feature parity diffs.
- /submit: Self-service ingestion pipeline for AI founders to list verified tools.

---

## 2. Categories & Taxonomy Details

### Coding Agents (/categories/coding)
- Description: AI-first code editors, intelligent auto-completers, and autonomous agents capable of multi-file modifications, git branching, and architectural refactoring.
- Key Tools: Cursor AI, Claude 3.7 Sonnet, DeepSeek-R1, GitHub Copilot, v0 by Vercel.
- Average Price: $18/mo
- Free Tier Availability: 62%

### LLMs & Reasoning (/categories/llms)
- Description: Frontier foundation models equipped with extended reasoning tokens, million-token context windows, and tool execution engines.
- Key Tools: Claude 3.7 Sonnet, DeepSeek-R1, ChatGPT 4o.
- Average Price: $20/mo
- Free Tier Availability: 55%

### Generative Art (/categories/art)
- Description: State-of-the-art diffusion and rectified flow models creating high-fidelity raster graphics, conceptual art, and commercial assets.
- Key Tools: Midjourney v7, Flux.1 Schnell, Recraft AI.
- Average Price: $12/mo
- Free Tier Availability: 48%

### Video & Animation (/categories/video)
- Description: Cinematic world models and camera-controllable video generation platforms.
- Key Tools: Runway Gen-3 Alpha, Kling AI.
- Average Price: $24/mo
- Free Tier Availability: 35%

### Research & Deep Search (/categories/search)
- Description: Real-time search intelligence tools that index academic repositories and live web nodes with verifiable citations.
- Key Tools: Perplexity Pro, NotebookLM.
- Average Price: $15/mo
- Free Tier Availability: 70%

### Voice & Speech (/categories/audio)
- Description: Multilingual voice cloning, expressive synthetic narration, and bidirectional realtime voice APIs.
- Key Tools: ElevenLabs Prime, Whisper Large v3.
- Average Price: $10/mo
- Free Tier Availability: 58%

### Productivity & Assistants (/categories/productivity)
- Description: Workspace operating systems that automate notes, summarize threads, and triage workflows.
- Key Tools: Notion AI, Julius AI.
- Average Price: $10/mo
- Free Tier Availability: 50%
